hero.title: Home is **14 Mile and Kelly.**
hero.lede: Refresh My Ride is a Clinton Township shop: 33115 Louise Ave, on the north side of 14 Mile Road just east of Kelly Road. Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction are done here, indoors. Detailing can be done here, in your driveway or by valet. Appointment only, Monday to Friday.

about.title: Three corridors, one river, no downtown.
body: Clinton Township runs from 14 Mile Road at its south edge to Hall Road at the north, with Fraser and Mount Clemens carved out of what began as a standard six mile square. It has no traditional downtown. The township is known by three corridors, Groesbeck Highway, Gratiot Avenue and Hall Road, and the three branches of the Clinton River come together inside its borders. Here is what that does to a vehicle, and what we do about it.

points.title: Three state highways and I-94
points.body: Hall Road (M-59), Gratiot (M-3) and Groesbeck (M-97) are state highways. With I-94, they are among the heaviest traveled roads in the township. State and primary roads are where county plows and salt trucks start when it snows. The salt rides home on rocker panels and floor mats, and stays until it is washed off the paint and extracted from the carpet.

points.title: Where a mobile detail fits
points.body: Single-family subdivisions take up the largest share of the township's land, and a driveway with room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle is the easy case. Apartment and condo complexes cluster along Hayes Road, Garfield Road and 19 Mile Road. There, tell us about the parking first. With the shop in the same township, a drop-off or valet pickup is an easy second choice.

points.title: Dogs at the mall, kayaks on the river
points.body: The Mall at Partridge Creek is open-air and welcomes dogs. George George Memorial Park has a kayak and canoe launch on the Clinton River. So the back of the car gets dog hair one weekend and river mud and wet gear the next. Steam and hot water extraction are how it all comes back out.

points.title: A cruise on Gratiot every August
points.body: The Clinton Township Gratiot Cruise runs Gratiot Avenue between 14 Mile Road and Wellington Crescent on the first Sunday in August. Our shop is just off 14 Mile too, west of Gratiot. Parked in full sun with people walking past, paint shows every swirl mark. Paint correction is the machine polishing that removes them. It is shop work, done before any ceramic coating goes on.

logistics.title: The shop is in town. Mobile and valet still come to you.
body: We are at 33115 Louise Ave, on the north side of 14 Mile Road just east of Kelly Road. That corner is the south edge of the township: Fraser is across Kelly Road and Roseville is across 14 Mile. From the north end, take Garfield Road south to 14 Mile Road and turn east. Louise Ave is on the left after Kelly Road. From Gratiot, turn west on 14 Mile and Louise Ave is on the right, before Kelly Road. From the Civic Center on Romeo Plank Road it is about 6 miles, roughly 15 minutes without traffic.

The shop is appointment only, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and closed on weekends. We are often out on mobile and valet jobs, so call or text (586) 400-1303 or book online before you head over. Online booking is open 24/7, and with an appointment we will have a bay ready for you.

Living close does not mean you have to make the trip. A detail, inside, outside or both, can be done in your driveway or at your workplace, since we bring our own power and water. Coating, tint and paint correction stay in our enclosed bays, under controlled lighting, even if you live around the corner. For those, valet picks the vehicle up, we do the work at the shop, and we bring it back. On coating jobs your Uber is covered for the drop-off and pickup.

faq.q: Where is your shop in Clinton Township?
faq.a: 33115 Louise Ave, Clinton Township, MI 48035. Louise Ave is on the north side of 14 Mile Road, just east of Kelly Road and west of Gratiot. From the Civic Center on Romeo Plank Road that is about 6 miles, roughly 15 minutes without traffic. It is a 2,000 square foot indoor shop and it is appointment only, so book before you come by.

faq.q: Can I stop in without an appointment?
faq.a: Please book first. We are appointment only, and the crew is often out on mobile and valet jobs. Call or text (586) 400-1303 Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, or book online at any hour. With an appointment, a bay is ready for your vehicle when you pull in.

faq.q: I live a few minutes away. Do you still offer mobile detailing and valet here?
faq.a: Yes, both. Mobile detailing is done at your home or workplace with our own power and water. We need a driveway or a parking spot with room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle, which matters most at apartment and condo lots. If the space is tight, valet is the answer: we pick the vehicle up, detail it at the shop and bring it back. See [how mobile and valet work](/mobile-detailing/).

faq.q: Which services have to be done at the shop?
faq.a: Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction. All three need enclosed bays and controlled lighting, and a coating has to cure in the shop before the vehicle goes back outside. Detailing is the one service that can come to you. For [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating/), plan on leaving the vehicle with us for at least a full day. We cover your Uber for the drop-off and pickup on coating jobs.

faq.q: What do detailing and window tint cost?
faq.a: Prices are listed for a coupe or sedan in average condition. [Detailing](/car-detailing-services-clinton-township-mi/) is from $139.99 for a Wash & Seal, from $184.99 for a Premium Interior Detail and from $249.99 for an Essential Refresh, inside and out. [Window tint](/window-tint-clinton-township-mi/) is from $99.99 for the front two windows in Geoshield C2 Carbon film. SUVs and trucks are quoted for their size. Ceramic coating is quoted per vehicle, so request a free quote and tell us what you drive.
